displayName: 美国（阿尔弗雷德·F·琼斯） America (Alfred F. Jones)
description: Unofficial fan art of America (Alfred F. Jones) from Hetalia. A fully clothed companion adjusting glasses beside a hamburger, presenting a toy airplane, dribbling and catching a basketball, waiting with the ball tucked safely under one arm, hopping with the ball held close, and running with articulated strides. Simplified neutral flight-style clothing without military insignia. Original choreography; no official affiliation.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
